description: A curated drug–disease contraindication from DrugCentral, directed from the Compound to the Disease. Relationships are limited to compounds and disease concepts represented in SPOKE; drug approval status does not restrict coverage. A source disease concept can correspond to more than one represented Disease.

common_properties.name: act_sources
common_properties.description: Distinct databases contributing target-binding or bioactivity data for the compound, such as ChEMBL or PDSP. These are compound-level bioactivity sources, not clinical evidence sources for this contraindication.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting the contraindication; DrugCentral is the current contributing source.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of the relationship’s creation or last update.
common_properties.notes: ISO datetime of last create or update.

source_contributions.scope: Curated contraindication relationships, without a drug approval-status filter. Only drug structures with a ChEMBL identifier corresponding to a represented Compound and disease concepts corresponding to represented Disease nodes are included. Unrepresented compounds or disease concepts are excluded.
source_contributions.description: DrugCentral supplies drug–disease contraindications. Its bioactivity-source annotation describes the compound’s target-binding data and does not identify the clinical evidence supporting the individual contraindication.
